summary: Mana Island Airport (MNF) is a small domestic airstrip located on Mana Island in Fiji's Mamanuca Islands archipelago, serving primarily the popular Mana Island Resort and nearby island getaways. The airport receives short-hop flights from Nadi International Airport, offering visitors a quick scenic transfer to one of Fiji's most accessible island destinations. Its compact single-runway layout is typical of Fiji's resort airports, designed to handle small turboprop aircraft.
faqs:
Q: How do I get to Mana Island Airport?
A: The airport is served by short domestic flights from Nadi International Airport, operated by small turboprop aircraft with a flight time of approximately 15-20 minutes.

Q: Which airlines fly into Mana Island Airport?
A: Several Fijian domestic carriers operate scheduled and charter services to Mana Island, including flights that connect with international arrivals at Nadi.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small resort airstrip, Mana Island Airport has very basic facilities including a small terminal area; most services are provided by the adjacent Mana Island Resort.

Q: Can I book a transfer directly from Nadi to Mana Island?
A: Yes, most resorts on Mana Island can arrange combined flight and transfer bookings, often including a short boat ride from the airport to the resort.
transport_tips: Arrange your domestic flight in advance through your resort, as schedules are limited and may not align with all international arrivals. Lightweight luggage is recommended, as transfers between the small airstrip and resort areas are typically brief walks or short boat rides. Confirm flight times the day before, as small-airport schedules in Fiji can change due to weather conditions.
local_tip: Sit on the left side of the aircraft when departing Nadi for stunning aerial views of the Mamanuca Islands as you approach Mana.
